subject: sleep detection of the first night

messages.author: 976308e02d9dcc1a
messages.subject: sleep detection of the first night
parts:
Dear Vincent!
Dear Group Members!

We would like to estimate sleeping time. The sleep algorithm works fine for all days except for the first night (starting with Sunday midnight). We had 7 days of measuring from Monday (00:01) to Sunday (23:59). Does anybody know a way to estimate sleep also for the first night although there is no interval "overstretching two days"? Since it should be similar to nights when participants went to bed after midnight...
We do not have a sleep log and used the following parameters in part 4:

excludefirstlast = FALSE,
             includenightcrit = 1,
             def.noc.sleep = c(1),
             loglocation= c(),
             outliers.only = FALSE,
             criterror = 4,
             relyonsleeplog = FALSE,
             sleeplogidnum = TRUE,
             colid=1,
             coln1=2,
             do.visual = TRUE,
             nnights = 9,


Thank you very much!

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] sleep detection of the first night
parts:
Part 5 does this to extract the waking up time from the first incomplete night. So, if you are interested in the waking-up time then it should be reported in the part5 output.
For part4 I intentionally did not implement this because I did not expect value of it for sleep research. How would you report sleep duration if you know the measurement does not cover the entire night?

What you could do to trick the code is to use dayborder = 1, in that way it will use 1am as midnight and will give you an estimate for the first night..I suppose you could to the same for the last night by changing dayborder to -1. I have never tried this myself, so if it does not work then I am afraid I cannot help you further.
Vincent
